title: Nightly sales ETL
body: A retail company has 50 GB of daily sales CSV files landing in S3 at 2 AM. Analysts need a dashboard by 8 AM. Design the pipeline.
solution:
**Approach:** S3 event → orchestrator (Airflow/Databricks Job) → Spark read CSV bronze Delta → silver dedupe/validate → gold daily aggregates → Power BI/Tableau.

**Key decisions:** Batch window fits SLA; partition bronze by `ingest_date`; MERGE silver on `order_id`; DQ checks (null PK, amount > 0); alert if job misses 8 AM freshness.

title: Hourly inventory sync
body: Warehouse inventory updates every hour via API (paginated JSON). Need inventory table in lake within 90 minutes.
solution:
**Approach:** Scheduled job pulls API → bronze JSON → silver flatten + type cast → MERGE on `sku_id`.

**Idempotency:** Use `api_batch_id` + `sku_id`; store raw response in bronze for replay.

title: Migrate data warehouse to lakehouse
body: Team wants to move raw Parquet on S3 to governed tables with ACID. 200 TB historical data.
solution:
**Approach:** Convert to Delta/Iceberg via `CONVERT` or rewrite jobs; Unity Catalog/Glue for governance; phased migration by domain.

**Tradeoffs:** Rewrite cost vs in-place conversion; enable OPTIMIZE/VACUUM schedule.

title: Bronze layer for SaaS exports
body: Daily Salesforce exports (CSV) with varying columns. Design bronze ingestion.
solution:
**Approach:** Land as-is with `_file_name`, `_ingest_ts`, `_row_hash`; schema evolution allowed; no business logic.

**Why:** Preserves audit trail; silver handles schema mapping.

title: Order events to analytics
body: E-commerce emits 10K orders/sec as JSON to Kafka. Need real-time revenue dashboard and daily reconciliation.
solution:
**Approach:** Kafka topic `orders` (key=customer_id) → Flink 1-min tumbling revenue → Redis/ClickHouse for dashboard; parallel Spark batch daily from bronze Delta fed by Kafka Connect.

**Lambda note:** Reconcile stream totals vs batch gold nightly.

title: PostgreSQL CDC to lake
body: OLTP Postgres 2 TB, need near-real-time customer dimension in lake. Deletes must propagate.
solution:
**Approach:** Debezium → Kafka `db.public.customers` → Spark Structured Streaming MERGE Delta silver SCD2.

**Deletes:** `op=d` tombstone → mark `is_active=false` or hard delete per policy.

title: Batch vs stream for clickstream
body: 100M events/day, product wants both real-time funnel and daily reports. Recommend architecture.
solution:
**Recommend:** Kappa-ish — Kafka bronze → Flink for 5-min funnel (gold RT table) + Spark daily aggregation from same bronze.

**Avoid:** Separate ingestion paths duplicating logic; share silver conformed events.

title: Pipeline missed SLA
body: Gold `daily_revenue` was 3 hours late. How do you respond and prevent recurrence?
solution:
**Response:** Communicate stakeholders, check upstream delays, rerun from last good checkpoint, validate counts.

**Prevent:** SLA monitors on freshness, critical path alerting, buffer in schedule, dependency sensors in Airflow, runbook.

title: Quarantine bad records
body: 5% of incoming IoT sensor readings are out of range. Design handling without blocking good data.
solution:
**Approach:** Validate in silver; split valid → merge gold, invalid → quarantine Delta table + DLQ metrics; alert if invalid rate > threshold.

**Replay:** Fix rules and reprocess quarantine batch.

title: Silver to gold for star schema
body: Silver has normalized orders, customers, products. Design gold for BI star schema.
solution:
**Approach:** Spark job builds `fact_orders` (grain: order_line) and dims with surrogate keys; slowly changing dim Type 2 on customer.

**Partition:** `order_date`; Z-order on `customer_id` for Delta.

title: Iceberg vs Delta choice
body: Multi-engine team uses Spark, Flink, and Trino. Recommend table format.
solution:
**Recommend Iceberg** for broad engine support and hidden partitioning.

**If** all-in Databricks → Delta + Unity Catalog. Document catalog choice and migration path.

title: Kafka consumer lag spike
body: Consumer lag grew to 6 hours on payments topic (32 partitions). Diagnose and fix.
solution:
**Diagnose:** Slow processing, rebalance, deploy restart, downstream throttle, skewed keys.

**Fix:** Scale consumers to 32, optimize processing, fix hot partitions (salt keys), increase retention temporarily, replay with parallel batch catch-up.

title: CDC schema breaking change
body: Source adds NOT NULL column without default. CDC stream breaks. Design resilience.
solution:
**Approach:** Schema Registry compatibility BACKWARD; Debezium schema change event → pause consumer → migrate silver schema → deploy new code → resume.

**Prevention:** Contract tests, staging CDC mirror, nullable defaults on source.

title: Backfill 2 years orders
body: New gold metric needs 2 years history while streaming continues. Design backfill.
solution: **Approach:** Snapshot bronze/archive OR batch from source DB → write to `gold_orders_v2` partition by month; dual-run streaming to new logic on new table; validate row counts vs old gold; atomic swap view.

title: Define SLAs for 50 gold tables
body: Platform has 50 gold tables with mixed criticality. How to tier and monitor?
solution:
**Tier 1:** 1h freshness, page on breach. **Tier 2:** 24h, email. **Tier 3:** best effort.

**Monitor:** Unified freshness table (max event time vs now); Monte Carlo/DataDog; ownership per domain.

title: End-to-end DQ observability
body: Executives want trust metrics across bronze/silver/gold. Design framework.
solution: **Approach:** Great Expectations suites per layer; metrics → Prometheus/Grafana; freshness + completeness + accuracy scores per dataset; lineage in OpenLineage; monthly trust report.

title: Medallion for ML features
body: Data science needs feature store from same medallion layers. Design integration.
solution:
**Approach:** Gold feature tables (point-in-time correct joins from silver SCD2); Feast or Databricks Feature Store reads gold; training snapshots via time travel Delta.

**Avoid:** Leakage — always join features as-of event time.

title: Time travel for audit
body: Regulator requires point-in-time data snapshots for 7 years. Design on Delta Lake.
solution: **Approach:** Retain history via retention policy + periodic VACUUM exceptions for audit tables; `DESCRIBE HISTORY` / `TIMESTAMP AS OF` for investigations; export monthly snapshots to WORM storage.

title: Exactly-once Kafka to warehouse
body: Finance requires exactly-once ledger entries from Kafka to Snowflake. Design.
solution: **Approach:** Idempotent MERGE on `transaction_id`; consumer stores offsets in same transaction as load (Kafka Connect EOS) OR Flink two-phase commit; dedupe table on `(topic, partition, offset)` as safety net.

title: Global multi-region ingestion
body: Users in US, EU, APAC generate events. GDPR requires EU data in EU. Design.
solution: **Approach:** Regional Kafka clusters → regional bronze buckets (S3 eu-west-1, etc.); separate processing; global gold only for aggregated non-PII metrics; no cross-border PII replication.
